sources: house sheets: OpenFC-Lite-Mini rp2350a/imu/osd/blackbox, OpenRX-Lite RF section, OpenAIO root current sense

conventions.refs: project-wide sequential per prefix (LINEUP A15), sheet order power, ESC1..ESC4, rp2354a, imu, blackbox, osd, rx_esp32_sx1280, vtx, led, pads; prefixes C R L D U Q X J TP AE FL FB TH H LOGO
conventions.footprint: OpenDrone:<name> = hardware/KiCad-Library footprint that passes check_footprint.py against its datasheet spec; lib:<name> = project library hardware/lib.pretty (P3 merge 2026-10-09; _W = corrected copy of an OpenDrone footprint, _Dense = area-budget variant); land specs in hardware/tools/land_specs/<name>.json
conventions.symbol: OpenDrone:<name> / KiCad stock (Device, Connector, Connector_Generic, Mechanical) / lib:<name> = hardware/lib.kicad_sym (P3 merge 2026-10-09)
conventions.coordinates: regions: KiCad top view, mm from the board-body centre (113.2, 113.2), +x right, +y down, front corner (+x,-y); side F/B
conventions.pads: solder pads Connector_Generic:Conn_01x01 ref J, dnp + exclude_from_bom (LINEUP A16); test points Connector:TestPoint ref TP, out of BOM; silk = the <=3-character pad code (0.8 mm Tokyo, D12) shared by schematic value, silk, pinout and docs
conventions.passives: 0201 default (owner rule); 0402/0603 only where DC bias or power needs it (noted per line); X6S in ESC quarters and at the PA, X5R elsewhere (spec §4 temperature grades)
conventions.lcsc: null where no LCSC number was read in the spec/catalogue; fill at P3/O17, never guessed
conventions.values: 'start value' notes mark circuit values closed in the P4 critique loop (spec §15.5, D22)

meta.not_parts: silk labels, product name OPEN/AIO/WHOOP, REV1, '1S', 'HD' frame are drawn by the generator, not footprints; no Wi-Fi radiator (D18); no SH1.0 parts (D18); no USB ESD array (§4.2)
meta.library: P3 merge 2026-10-09: staged libraries merged (research/LIBRARY.md); footprint ids switched to the checked _W/_Dense variants; the 17 OpenDrone footprints used without staged work failed check_footprint against their datasheet lands and were replaced by checked lib _W/_Dense copies in the same frame; D1 SMF5.0A (unidirectional) moved from the bidirectional Device:D_TVS (A1/A2) to Device:D_Zener (1 = K, 2 = A) so the cathode pad 1 is unambiguous
